verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a payments-onboarding platform could publish a country, payment-method and currency coverage map, but the evidence contains none. The only related items are a list of payment methods (card, PayPal, Venmo, ACH, Apple Pay) and onboarding docs referencing Social Security Numbers and routing numbers. These suggest a single-market scope rather than documenting supported onboarding countries, local payment methods by region, or local-currency settlement.
